top_stories.title: The Identity Crisis No One Planned For: Governing Non-Human Agents at Enterprise Scale
top_stories.summary: The article addresses the emerging IAM challenge of governing non-human identities (agents, service accounts, bots) at enterprise scale. It focuses on how traditional IGA frameworks built around human user lifecycle management are inadequate for managing the rapidly growing population of non-human identities.

top_stories.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
top_stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" enables adversary-in-the-middle attacks against Microsoft 365 for $320 per month, stealing session cookies to bypass authentication controls. The service targets Microsoft 365 sessions, allowing attackers to hijack authenticated sessions rather than just stealing credentials, undermining MFA protections.

top_stories.title: NovaCookies Campaigns Abuse Genuine Docusign Notifications to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions
top_stories.summary: Researchers have disclosed a new adversary-in-the-middle phishing toolkit called NovaCookies, sold as a $320/month subscription service, that proxies Microsoft 365 sign-in pages to capture authenticated session cookies. The toolkit abuses legitimate DocuSign notifications to lure victims and bypasses MFA by stealing post-authentication sessions rather than credentials.

top_stories.title: Okta Q2 2027 earnings beat estimates as AI agent security drives growth
top_stories.summary: Okta reported Q2 2027 revenue of $805 million, up 11% year-over-year, beating analyst expectations of $795 million and driving a 20% stock surge in extended trading. The company attributed growth in part to AI agent security, reflecting expanding demand for identity solutions in agentic AI environments.

top_stories.title: Okta Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
top_stories.summary: Okta reported its Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings, citing broad-based demand across its workforce and customer identity platforms. The results reflect continued market activity for Okta's core IAM product lines.

news.title: Key Reasons Why Identity Fabric Matters in 2026
news.summary: The article explains the concept of Identity Fabric as an architectural approach that integrates fragmented identity systems into a unified layer for runtime visibility across applications, APIs, and infrastructure. It covers Identity Fabric architecture, risks associated with unmanaged identities, and its relevance as enterprise access increasingly spans cloud services and automated workloads.

news.title: Okta skyrockets 20%, CrowdStrike surges 15% as rising AI threat boosts earnings
news.summary: Okta shares surged approximately 20% following earnings results that beat Wall Street estimates for the fiscal second quarter, with the company also raising its forward guidance. AI adoption was cited as a key driver pushing customers to increase spending on cybersecurity tools, including Okta's identity management products.

news.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Rally on Twin Earnings Beats: Okta Spikes 22%, CrowdStrike Jumps 13%
news.summary: Okta's stock spiked 22% and CrowdStrike's jumped 13% following fiscal Q2 2027 earnings beats from both cybersecurity companies. Okta's strong quarterly results signal continued growth for the IAM vendor in a competitive market.

news.title: Integrity360 agrees deal for identity specialist CyberIAM
news.summary: Integrity360 has agreed to acquire identity specialist CyberIAM, which operates in the UK and South Africa. The deal expands Integrity360's identity and access management capabilities through the purchase of a dedicated IAM services firm.

news.title: CISA Red Team Compromised Two Critical Infrastructure Orgs, One Detected Nothing
news.summary: CISA published results of two simultaneous red team assessments against critical infrastructure organizations, both of which were fully compromised at the domain level. One organization detected none of the intrusion activity, highlighting gaps in defensive capabilities relevant to identity and access controls.

news.title: Fake Apple Support AI Calls Target Stolen-Device Owners for Passcodes and 2FA Codes
news.summary: Researchers at SOCRadar identified a phishing-as-a-service platform called AnonyMousKIT that uses AI voice agents to impersonate Apple Support and trick stolen device owners into revealing passcodes and 2FA codes. The platform is credit-metered and targets Apple's Activation Lock mechanism by socially engineering victims over phone calls.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Okta shares jump on second-quarter beats and raised outlooks
news.summary: Okta reported better-than-expected second-quarter financial results, causing its shares to rise more than 19% in after-hours trading. Okta also raised its forward financial outlook following the earnings beat.

news.title: Okta Lifts Full-Year Outlook as AI Agents Spur Demand
news.summary: Okta raised its full-year revenue outlook to $3.22–$3.23 billion, up from its previous guidance of $3.19–$3.21 billion. The company cited growing demand driven by AI agents as a factor in the improved forecast.

news.title: Okta Earnings Top Estimates. Cybersecurity Firm's Sales Outlook Above Views
news.summary: Okta reported Q2 earnings and revenue that exceeded analyst estimates, with its sales outlook also coming in above expectations. The results reflect the financial performance of one of the leading identity and access management platform providers.

news.title: Okta pops 15% after topping estimates as AI threat spikes demand for identity security
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal second-quarter results that exceeded Wall Street estimates, with adjusted EPS of $1.05 against an expected 97 cents, sending shares up approximately 15% in extended trading. The company attributed stronger-than-expected demand to AI-driven threats increasing the need for identity security solutions.

news.title: CyberFOX review: A privileged access tool built for teams that don’t have time for one
news.summary: A review of CyberFOX, a privileged access management (PAM) tool, was published targeting IT teams with limited resources. The review focuses on the product's usability and design philosophy for smaller or under-resourced IT operations managing privileged access.

news.title: infisical v0.162.24
news.summary: Infisical released version 0.162.24 of its open-source secrets management and privileged access management platform. The platform includes features such as secret scanning, dynamic secrets, PKI, and CI/CD integrations, available as cloud-native or self-hosted deployments.

news.title: INE Launches eIAMA Certification to Help Organizations Build Practical Identity and Access Management Skills
news.summary: INE has launched the eIAMA, a new vendor-neutral certification aimed at cybersecurity and IT professionals focused on identity and access management skills. The certification is designed to prepare practitioners to implement, operate, and secure identity systems in modern enterprise environments.

news.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
news.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposed master keys to the password vault, affecting MSPs and SMBs that rely on the product. The flaw raises concerns about cloud-based password vault architectures, as the cloud design itself is cited as a residual risk even after the patch was applied.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft including over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem after a contractor exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection and response processes relevant to IAM and privileged access management practices.
